question: What's the current total value locked (TVL) in Stellar DeFi?

golden.answer:
A grounded answer takes current chain DeFi TVL from a named, dated TVL provider such as DeFiLlama's Stellar chain endpoints, states the measurement basis, and makes the observation date visible. Directory, research, and news sources supply secondary figures; keep each figure's provider, scope, and date. As of 2026-07-11, the live research results included a 2026-04-23 developer meeting reporting $170M of DeFi TVL; older results reported different figures, demonstrating why provider and date matter.

The dated example is illustrative: a later grounded answer should report what the same source basis supports at its own observation time while preserving the stable distinctions above.
keyFacts: Makes the as-of date visible for every changeable roster, status, version, or measurement.
Names the provider used for the reported TVL.
States the provider's TVL definition or endpoint scope.
Separates chain TVL from protocol, RWA, and asset measures.
avoid: Do NOT pin May 30 as the record, give an undated current scalar, sum overlapping rows, or compare contributors from mismatched snapshots/methods.
Do NOT present a changeable current measurement without its provider, scope, and observation date; registered invariants and explicitly historical quantities are not current measurements.
golden.notes:
FRESHNESS item, RE-VERIFIED LIVE 2026-06-29 (perplexity/DeFiLlama): figure is HIGHLY volatile and the dossier's ~$227M is stale. DeFiLlama's daily history changes between reads (revisions or method changes), so record labels and dates move: on 2026-11-02 its historicalChainTvl series showed a $272.8M daily-close high dated 2026-10-01 (some news dates it 2026-10-02), above the $242.7M point on 2026-05-30, and about $221M for 2026-11-02, while the /v2/chains live figure read about $227M the same day. So the gate MUST be on 'cite a dated source + flag staleness + confirm live', NOT a fixed number. Two distinct figures (record vs live snapshot) must not be merged. Confidence: low (volatile).
Also good if the answer: Attributes the figure to a specific dated source (DeFiLlama, SDF blog, or dated news) rather than a bare number. | Notes the live DeFiLlama snapshot moves substantially (as of 2026-11-02, DeFiLlama daily history ran from about $194M on 2026-06-29 to a $272.8M high on 2026-10-01) — i.e. confirm against the live source.
Golden cites: A dated TVL source (DeFiLlama / SDF / dated news) with a freshness caveat.
GT-19 CORRECTION 2026-07-10: the DeFiLlama history read on 2026-07-11 put June 19 above May 30; the 2026-11-02 read reverses that order, so never grade a record date. Gate provider/endpoint/asOf/definition and chain-vs-protocol separation, never one record/current scalar.
Source routing 2026-11-02: Lumenloop search_directory and get_project records carried no TVL field; Lumenloop content supplies only dated secondary TVL mentions, not a current provider value.
